text:
alex: Observability alert — sudden 429 spike for multiple orgs starting ~1883123456. Dash shows per-org burst errors, top affected: org=acme-inc, org=brightdata. Can someone check recent console changes? :rotating_light:

sam: I see it too. QPS per-key looks normal, but burst allowance dropped to 0 for a lot of orgs. Graph: https://console/redwood/metrics/alerts/1883123456

maya: Paging audit logs now. Quick skim: there was a bulk quota edit around 1883123400 from leah (console UI). Action was "Copy settings to all orgs" in the quotas page.

leah: yep, I ran a bulk update to standardize burst_multiplier across trial orgs. Thought it would be additive. :grimacing: I didn't expect it to overwrite per-org burst windows.

sam: logs show translation service applied multiplier=0.0 instead of delta. snippet from policy diff: ```- burst_multiplier: 1.5
+ burst_multiplier: 0.0```

alex: Oof. That explains the clamps. Which code path handles console->controlplane translation? Is it quota-service or the console backend?

maya: The console sends a payload to /internal/orgs/bulk_quota_apply which hits quota-service via the control-plane translation lambda. I see an edge case: when field is unset in UI it serializes as null and the translator treats null as explicit 0.0.

jordan: Can we rollback? Options: 1) revert console action (UI has history), 2) run a one-off script to restore previous multipliers from audit logs. I can run (2) if we want faster.

leah: Please do (2). I'm on it to coordinate. Sorry team.

jordan: Running restore script now against orgs in the alert query. Will PATCH quota entries with the last-known-good multiplier from audit. Command I'm running: ```for o in $(cat affected_orgs.txt); do curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://controlplane.internal/orgs/$o/quota -d '{"burst_multiplier":1.5}'; done```

ops-bot: Rate limiter note: throttles are high but not saturated. Applying restores may cause short-lived bursts. Monitor.

deploy-bot: Incident workflow started by alex. Severity: S2. Triage channel: #incidents.

sam: Patch script finished for top 50 orgs at 1883123520, error rate dropping. Can we hold on further bulk edits until translator null-handling is fixed?

maya: I'll open a PR to change translator: treat null as "no-op" instead of 0.0, add unit test + integration check. Also adding a console confirmation modal for bulk overwrite.

leah: Thanks everyone — will follow-up in postmortem. I'll coordinate writing the customer comms for any orgs that saw degraded throughput. :pray:

alex: For the record: root cause = console bulk-update UI + translator treating null as explicit zero -> overwrote per-org burst_multiplier to 0.0 -> 429 spike. Resolution: rolled back via PATCH script, fix inbound for translator + console guardrails. Postmortem assigned to maya and leah.

jordan: Closing incident when 429s stable below threshold for 15m. Current 429 rate ~1% of peak at 1883123558.

alex: Thanks. Postmortem ETA 24h.
